stages.name: Stop the bleeding: secret handling + revocation readiness
fixes: K-06: route validation_create through a file/stdin secret path and document it; never accept secrets on the command line
K-02: publish a tested master-key revocation runbook (revocation manifest + list update) and rehearse it on testnet
stages.exit: A revocation can be published end-to-end on testnet within one hour of decision, without putting a secret on any command line.

stages.name: Make rotation real: tooling + policy
fixes: K-04: ship an in-tree manifest minting/rotation tool (the test helper logic, productized) with sequence management
K-05: document the rotation procedure and a recommended cadence; publish each validator's rotation policy
K-15: track sequence numbers per validator and alert on staleness
stages.exit: Any validator can rotate its ephemeral key with one command; rotation events are visible in the manifest sequence history.

stages.name: Detection: notice compromise before it is exploited
fixes: K-03: add manifest/validation anomaly monitoring (unexpected sequence jumps, duplicate ephemeral keys, new master keys)
K-10: add optional manifest expiry (not-valid-after) so stale manifests die without operator action
stages.exit: A compromised-key scenario is detected by monitoring, not by an operator happening to notice.

stages.name: Post-quantum design: version the format, stage the migration
fixes: K-07: define manifest version 1 with a PQ-capable field layout and a dual-version acceptance window
K-01: parameterize ValidatorKeys/validation_create over key type instead of hardcoding secp256k1
K-14: adopt the staged hybrid (master-only ML-DSA-44 first, 3,872 B) before full PQ; set a gossip/cache budget for 7,502 B manifests
stages.exit: A version-1 manifest verifies on a test build; staged hybrid manifests stay within the gossip budget.

stages.name: Migrate and operate
fixes: K-08: make the untrusted-manifest bound size-aware
K-09: complete the dual-key migration and retire secp256k1-only paths
K-11/K-12/K-13: authenticate domains where relied upon, publish validator inventory via the node, remove the master-key fallback
stages.exit: All testnet validators run PQ or hybrid manifests; secp256k1-only validation keys are gone.

open_decisions.decision: Manifest version 1 field layout: which PQ algorithms are permitted per key slot (ML-DSA-44 only, or a small set)
Whether the master key migrates first or the ephemeral key migrates first (this pack recommends master-first: 3,872 B vs 3,865 B is a wash on size; master-first retires the long-lived key sooner)
Gossip/cache budget for PQ manifests: keep 1000 unlisted manifests (7.5 MB at ML-DSA-44) or lower the bound
Manifest expiry length, if any (no expiry exists today; a value must be chosen before K-10 can ship)
Whether validation_create stays admin-only RPC or moves to a dedicated offline tool (the CLI-leak warning pushes toward offline)
